messages.subject: Req38455 | Sustainability leadership for MIGA Industries | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Di Iorio,

I am writing regarding MIGA's Manager, Sustainability, Industries opportunity, Req38455. The mandate to protect environmental and social standards while helping the World Bank Group Guarantee Platform mobilize more private capital into infrastructure and industry speaks directly to the intersection in which I have built my career: international investment, government, responsible operations, communities and accountable execution in an emerging-market setting.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My country-facing mandate spans ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination, executive advisory and cross-functional delivery. I work across ministries, regulators, communities and internal operating teams, translating external expectations into accountable owners, evidence, corrective actions, deadlines and management decisions.

My perspective is grounded in the operating side of a capital-intensive industry. I support social investment, workforce development, community engagement and grievance follow-up, coordinate environmental and regulatory interfaces, and contribute to stakeholder governance around a major solar-plus-storage platform. I also coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot built from physical operating records across fuel, electricity, explosives, material movement, production and refinery datasets. Earlier in my career, I spent five years with Scotiabank Guyana, giving me an additional grounding in regulated financial services, controls and client-facing discipline.

For MIGA, I would bring practical experience connecting sustainability commitments with the realities of project execution, institutional relationships and business continuity. I have spent my career influencing across organizational boundaries, working with senior decision makers and coordinating sensitive issues where credibility depends on evidence, disciplined follow-through and clear communication.

I have attached a concise CV prepared specifically for Req38455. I would value your consideration and, if appropriate, a brief conversation about how this operator-side sustainability and stakeholder leadership experience might contribute to MIGA's Economics and Sustainability Department and the broader Guarantee Platform.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
